chosen_titles.rationale: Title 65 (Public Officers) contains the Lobbying Disclosure Act, codified at 65 Pa.C.S. Ch. 13A (sections 13A01-13A11), the state's lobbyist registration and disclosure regime.

notes: Single-regime state; PA 2010 prior also located the lobbying-disclosure body inside Title 65 Ch. 13A. Title 46 (LEGISLATURE) does not host a parallel lobbying-disclosure chapter in PA.
